node.statement: Write X=(X_i) and Y=(Y_i). Since X_i,Y_i lie in S_{P,Q}=Img(Co_{P,Q}), def-compressed-corner gives Co_{P,Q}(Y_i)^dagger=Co_{Q,P}(Y_i^dagger); hence Y_i^dagger lies in S_{Q,P}. Thus X lies in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} and Y^dagger lies in M_{1,n} tensor S_{Q,P} with the indicated orientations.
